title: Equal Treaty
next_chapter_hook: "The alliance is made, but as Chen Ji was about to leave, Ye Qing suddenly spoke—'There is one more matter.' A strange glint flickered in her deep eyes. 'Chen Xuan once caused the Holy Sect to lose three elders. This debt... do you think one alliance can clear it?'"

text.content:
The candlelight in the secret chamber flickered unstably, stretching and compressing the silhouettes of two figures. The token fragment in Ye Qing's palm glowed with a cold light, and the Chen family emblem appeared ferocious like a beast under the firelight. The four words 'Chen Xuan's son' carried the weight of a thousand jun, pressing down on the air and on Chen Ji's heart.

His expression remained normal; he even lifted the teacup before him and gently blew away the steam. Only his lowered eyelashes trembled slightly, revealing that momentary turmoil.

dialogue.content: "What, you don't want to know?" Ye Qing's lips curved slightly, turning the token fragment between her fingers. 'Who killed your father back then—this was precisely the first deal I wanted to discuss with you. Chen Ji, no matter how well you play the role of a useless person, the moment you obtained the Tianji Record, the look in your eyes couldn't deceive anyone.'"

The teacup lightly landed on the table with a crisp sound. Chen Ji raised his eyes; those seemingly murky eyes were now clear to the point of being cold. "Ye Holy Maiden is quite straightforward. Since that's the case—" he leaned back in his chair, "let's have a proper discussion on how this alliance should be established."

text.content: Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, seemingly not expecting him to agree so readily. She tucked the token fragment into her sleeve, placed her hands folded on the table, assuming a posture of attentive listening. The air in the secret chamber seemed to solidify, two old foxes facing each other across the table, each calculating.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji speaks first, proposing three conditions. How will he phrase them to show sincerity while not losing the initiative?

choices.text: Get straight to the point, address the core directly
choices.description: Directly lay out three conditions without beating around the bush, displaying confidence in controlling the overall situation
choices.risk_hint: If conditions are rejected, the situation will become passive

text.content: Chen Ji lightly tapped the table with his fingers, his voice cold and clear: 'First, the Demonic Path must provide clues about my father's death. Second, share intelligence on at least one secret realm entrance. Third—' he paused, his gaze sharp as a blade, 'Mutual non-aggression on core interests. Your Holy Sect does not set foot in Tianqing Sect by a single step, and I will not interfere with the Demonic Path's internal affairs.'

choices.text: Retreat to advance, lure the enemy deeper
choices.description: First show weakness to let the other party make an offer, then refute each point to build advantage
choices.visible_reward: Gauge the other party's bottom line
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may seize the opportunity to make excessive demands

text.content: Chen Ji slightly lowered his eyes, his voice dropping a few tones: 'Since Ye Holy Maiden proactively mentioned my father, you must have something in mind. Why don't... you make the first offer?' He raised his eyes, a flash of sharpness in his gaze disappearing in an instant. This move of retreating to advance not only showed 'sincerity' but also forced the other party to reveal their cards first—and whoever reveals their cards first often ends up at a disadvantage.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing listened quietly, then suddenly laughed. That laughter echoed in the secret chamber, carrying an indescribable meaning. 'Chen Ji, your three conditions... I'll accept the first two, but the third—' she leaned forward, the candlelight dancing in her eyes, 'what do you mean by 'core interests'? I don't care about that破烂 place called Tianqing Sect, but that fragment of Tianji Record of yours—does that count as your core interest?'

text.content: This was said brilliantly, both hinting at coveting the Tianji Record and kicking the ball back to Chen Ji. Ye Qing leaned back in her chair, her posture lazy yet hiding sharp edges beneath: 'I also have three conditions. If you agree, this alliance will be formed.'

dialogue.content: 'First, kill someone for me.' Ye Qing raised one finger, her tone as casual as discussing today's weather, 'The Grand Elder of Xuanwu Sect, Han Lie's master. This person has a private grudge with me. If you act, I will ensure your布局 in Xuanwu Sect remains unknown.'

'Second, enter a forbidden land and retrieve something.' She paused, 'Since the Tianji Record is your foundation, you should know—there is an ancient 'Furnace of Heavenly Fate' that can complete one's fate and reverse destiny. I want you to enter for me and retrieve a wisp of furnace fire.'
'Third—' Ye Qing's gaze suddenly turned sharp, 'I want you to owe me a favor. On some future day, when I tell you to do something, you will do it. No asking for reasons, no making excuses.'

text.content: The three demands grew increasingly harsh. The first was to involve him directly in sect conflicts, the second was to send him to die in an ancient forbidden land, and the third... would turn him completely into a chess piece of the Demonic Path. Chen Ji lightly rubbed the rim of his teacup, his expression betraying no joy or anger.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's three conditions grow increasingly harsh with each one. How should Chen Ji respond to these lethal demands?

choices.text: Reject outright, overturn the table and start over
choices.description: Point out the other party has no sincerity, the negotiation breaks but dignity is preserved
choices.visible_reward: Force Ye Qing to reassess his value
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may turn and leave, seeking other cooperation partners

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a hint of mockery. 'Ye Holy Maiden, these three conditions... are you humiliating me?' He set down his teacup, his voice still calm, 'The first requires me to kill someone, the second requires me to enter a forbidden land to die, the third requires me to sell myself into servitude? There's no business deal like this in the world.'

choices.description: Unexpectedly agree to all conditions, winning Ye Qing's trust before planning subsequent strategies slowly
choices.visible_reward: Completely infiltrate the Demonic Path and obtain core intelligence
choices.risk_hint: Any of the three promises if unfulfilled will lead to utter destruction

dialogue.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then nodded. 'Very well.' Only one word, so decisive that Ye Qing froze for an instant. He raised his eyes, his gaze flickering: 'But I also have one condition—each item, I require you to provide sufficient intelligence support. Otherwise, I must refuse.'

choices.text: Brandish the Tianji Record, display the future
choices.description: Use the prophetic ability to show Ye Qing the future she fears most, forcing her to reassess the situation
choices.visible_reward: Completely reverse the negotiation situation, putting Ye Qing at a disadvantage
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record's consumption is too great, and it exposes the specific cost of prophecy

text.content: Chen Ji did not respond. He slowly closed his eyes, and a faint light appeared in his palm. In the next moment, a illusory scene materialized in the secret chamber—a glimpse of the future as shown by the Tianji Record. Ye Qing's pupils contracted sharply. In the scene, she was bound by chains, Holy Sect experts were forcibly extracting her demonic roots...

dialogue.content: The scene shifted, showing her pierced by countless sword lights. Then changed again, her soul being devoured bit by bit by the Holy Sect's sect master... Finally settling on a smiling face—the Holy Sect's sect master looking down at her, his tone gentle: 'Good child, now you finally know that resistance is useless.'

The scene dissolved. Ye Qing's face was ashen white, her fingertips trembling slightly. She stared at Chen Ji, her eyes showing genuine wariness for the first time. 'You... saw my ending?' Her voice no longer held its previous composure, carrying a hint of hoarseness.

'There are countless possibilities in the future,' Chen Ji withdrew his palm, his expression serene, 'but in every possibility, you cannot escape the Holy Sect's sect master's grasp. He has been scheming against you from the beginning, Ye Holy Maiden. You think your defection from the Holy Sect was your own choice? No, that was precisely what he wanted.'

Ye Qing stared at him fixedly, her chest heaving剧烈ly. After a long while, she spoke again, but her voice was cold like it had been dipped in poison: 'What are you trying to prove by showing me this? That only by cooperating with you can I deal with the Holy Sect? That my value is greater than you thought?'

'No.' Chen Ji shook his head, 'I just want you to understand—we are people on the same boat. You have your deadly trap, I have my predicament. Instead of scheming against each other, let's join hands to break the situation.' He leaned forward slightly, 'So, change those three conditions.'

text.content: Silence fell over the secret chamber again. The candlelight crackled, two silhouettes confronting each other silently on the wall. This time, Ye Qing did not speak first. She was waiting—waiting for Chen Ji to reveal his trump card.

choice.prompt: The negotiation has reached a deadlock. Chen Ji takes the initiative to propose concessions. How will he make his move to completely win over Ye Qing?

choices.text: Abandon one's own conditions, trading for equal status
choices.description: Withdraw all three conditions, only seeking to establish an equal cooperative relationship
choices.visible_cost: Lose the opportunity to obtain clues about his father
choices.visible_reward: Win Ye Qing's genuine trust, establishing an equal alliance
choices.risk_hint: Abandoning too easily may raise suspicion

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a hint of desolation. 'Forget it.' He waved his hand, 'All three conditions are void. Of the three you proposed, I will only fulfill the first two. The third—' he looked directly at Ye Qing, 'I owe no one favors. But I can promise you one thing.'

choices.text: Reveal clues about his sister, trading sincerity for sincerity
choices.description: Disclose the intelligence that his sister Chen Nian is imprisoned in the Holy Sect, trading for Ye Qing's empathy and concessions
choices.visible_reward: Touch Ye Qing's heart, establishing a bond that transcends mere interests
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may use this intelligence to blackmail in reverse

dialogue.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, his voice suddenly dropping. 'I have a younger sister... named Chen Nian. She went missing many years ago.' He paused, 'Only recently did I discover that she might... be held somewhere in your Holy Sect.' He raised his eyes, 'This is the third condition I want to propose—help me find her. Find her, and we are sworn brothers till death.'

Ye Qing was stunned. She stared at Chen Ji as if seeing this person for the first time. That man who was watertight at the negotiating table, whose depths were unfathomable, now showed a trace of vulnerability in his eyes—that was a brother's obsession, the soft underbelly that a lone wolf finally revealed.

"Chen Nian..." she murmured, repeating this name, suddenly remembering something, her pupils slightly contracting, "Heavenly Fate Lock Key... so it's her." Ye Qing's expression grew complex, her gaze toward Chen Ji carrying an indescribable meaning. "No wonder the Holy Sect has been searching for her. So they intend to use her... to counter your Tianji Record."

Chen Ji did not deny. He simply watched Ye Qing quietly, waiting for her answer. The candlelight flickered in the secret chamber, two silhouettes crossing on the wall. At this moment, they were no longer chess players probing each other, but two pieces caught up in fate.

After a long while, Ye Qing took a deep breath and extended her hand. "Deal." Her voice regained composure, but deep in her eyes there was something Chen Ji could not see through. "From this day forward, you are a guest advisor of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, and I am an outside aid to Tianqing Sect. We each take what we need, do not interfere with each other. In matters of life and death, share information."

text.content: Two hands clasped under the candlelight. One was the hand of the Demonic Path's Holy Maiden, cold as jade; the other was the hand of a废物 servant, rough and covered with calluses. No one could have imagined that these two hands joined together would stir the winds and clouds of the entire cultivation world. The alliance was formed, but an unusual unease rose in Chen Ji's heart—Ye Qing's final gaze was too profoundly meaningful.

dialogue.content: After the handshake, Ye Qing did not withdraw her hand. She suddenly leaned forward, almost close to Chen Ji's ear, lowering her voice: "Since we are allies now, let me give you a piece of news—your good senior brother Ling Yuan has already sent people to watch you. He seems... to have also sensed the existence of the Tianji Record." She withdrew, a meaningful arc curving at the corner of her lips, "Be careful of the people around you."

text.content: With that, she turned and walked toward the depths of the secret chamber, her figure disappearing into the darkness. Chen Ji stood in place, gazing at the direction where she vanished, his eyes flashing with sharpness. Ling Yuan... this old fox indeed has not given up. He rubbed the Tianji Record fragment in his sleeve, already having his calculations. Tonight's博弈, though he seemed to have made many concessions, in truth every retreat was a precisely calculated chess piece being placed. Ye Qing thought she had gained the advantage, but she did not realize—the chess game had only just begun.
